summary: Deutsche Bank filed a Form 6-K containing its earnings report for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, along with a capitalization table. The filing is a routine periodic report of financial results. It includes forward-looking statements and risk factors cross-referenced to the annual report. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, or other corporate action is disclosed, nor is there any reference to an activist campaign, restructuring, or going-private transaction. Any ordinary-course earnings release that does not trigger a special situation classifies as "None."
